 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Each arrangement is a group of four separate figures. Return the odd figure
    # by its occupied cell pattern; identified via demo as top-left component.
    pts = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v]
    # find 4-connected components
    unseen=set(pts); comps=[]
    while unseen:
        stack=[unseen.pop()]; comp=set(stack)
        while stack:
            r,c=stack.pop()
            for q in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                if q in unseen:
                    unseen.remove(q); comp.add(q); stack.append(q)
        comps.append(comp)
    comp=max(comps,key=len)
    r0=min(r for r,c in comp); r1=max(r for r,c in comp)
    c0=min(c for r,c in comp); c1=max(c for r,c in comp)
    return [[int((r,c) in comp) for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
",

    pts={(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v}
